title: Ipswich Town x Arsenal: English League Cup Clash
seoTitle: Ipswich Town vs Arsenal: League Cup Showdown
subtitle: Everything fans need to know before the clash at Portman Road
excerpt: Arsenal and Ipswich Town face off this Tuesday at 4 PM BRT in the third round of the English League Cup.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Arsenal enters the English League Cup this Tuesday, facing Ipswich Town at Portman Road in Ipswich. The match, scheduled for 4 PM BRT, gained prominence after Ipswich's 3-1 victory over Leicester in the previous round.

What's at Stake in the League Cup

Both teams reach the third round of the competition with strong campaigns in the Premier League. Arsenal leads the league with 12 points from four rounds, while Ipswich sits in ninth place with two wins and two losses. The clash offers Arsenal the opportunity to advance in the competition after entering at this stage due to European commitments.

How to Get to Portman Road

Portman Road stadium in Ipswich will host the clash. The match takes place on Tuesday, September 15, and fans can reach the venue by the city's main transportation methods, including trains connecting Ipswich to London and urban buses circulating in areas near the stadium.

Predicted Lineups

Ipswich, managed by Gary O'Neil, is expected to field Scherpen; O'Shea, Issa Diop, Greaves, and Davis; Lukic, Palacios, and Enciso; Fatawu, Jack Clarke, and Flemming. Arsenal, under Mikel Arteta, has Kepa; White, Konsa, Gabriel Magalhães, and Hincapié; Zubimendi, Bruno Guimarães, and Merino; Madueke, Gyokeres, and Eze. Both teams feature young talents who could gain important minutes.

Absentees and Doubts

Ipswich has a doubt over Emerson, who suffered a muscle injury against Crystal Palace. If unavailable, Fleming or former Arsenal striker Chuba Akpom could take the center-forward position. For Arsenal, Ben White is out with a groin injury, being replaced by Jurriën Timber at right-back. William Saliba and Cristian Mosquera are still recovering, and Bruno Guimarães will be rested for the Champions League match, making way for Martin Subimendi, Mikel Merino, Eberechi Eze, and Victor Dijkeresh.

Where to Watch Live

The match will be broadcast live on Disney+. The service offers full coverage of the game, allowing fans in Brazil to follow the clash in real-time.

With information from GE, Terra.
